rent.notes: Immobiliare.it asking rents Oct 2026: Sardegna region 13.64 EUR/m2/mo, Cagliari province 13.16, Sassari 10.38, Oristano 9.01, Gallura 20.34; Cagliari city 14.06 (+5.7% y/y). Modeled on an 85-95 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR: typical ~1,100 (Cagliari/Sassari suburbs), min interior/Sassari-Oristano, max Cagliari centre or Gallura coast. Long-term pet-friendly stock is thin in tourist zones.

groceries.notes: ISTAT 2025 household food and non-alcoholic beverage spend averages 552 EUR/mo nationally (avg household ~2.2 people); Sardinian total household spend (2,431) is below the national level, so 2 adults modeled at ~480 plus ~55/mo of large-breed kibble (about 14 kg/mo) for a 100 lb dog. ISTAT Oct 2026 shows unprocessed food +7.5% y/y and carrello della spesa +2.5%, which is folded in.

utilities.notes: Facile.it Osservatorio Oct 2026: Sardinian households average 1,202 EUR/yr electricity (2,244 kWh) = ~100/mo; Sardinia has almost no methane grid so heating is LPG/pellet/heat-pump electric, modeled at ~40/mo averaged over the year. Water (UIL 2026 study, 180 m3) 520 EUR/yr in Cagliari/Sassari = 43/mo; TARI waste ~340 EUR/yr national average = 28/mo. ISTAT Oct 2026 shows regulated energy +59.5% y/y, hence the wide max. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Non-EU elective-residence retirees join the SSN by voluntary enrolment (iscrizione volontaria): 7.5% of income up to 20,658 EUR plus 4% up to 51,645, minimum 2,000 and maximum 2,789 EUR per person per calendar year (ASL Sassari / The Local). Two enrolments: min 2x2,000 = 333/mo, typical ~2x2,700 = 450/mo, max 2x2,789 plus a private top-up policy (Feather expat cover from 72/mo per person) ~670/mo. Re-modeled to carry the full health-coverage cost (old template put part in insurance).

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (110 = health) to tenant contents/liability only. Money.it (June 2026): basic Italian home policy (fire, liability, water damage) 120-180 EUR/yr, multi-risk incl. theft 200-350/yr; a tenant RC-locativa plus contents policy sits at ~180/yr = 15/mo.

petCare.notes: Finanza.com (updated Oct 2026): average yearly vet spend for a dog ~341 EUR, base visit from 39 EUR in the South, annual vaccines 40-80. A 100 lb dog needs weight-dosed flea/tick/heartworm and leishmaniasis prevention (endemic in Sardinia), so scaled to ~650 EUR/yr = 55/mo; max covers a senior-dog year with bloodwork.

petDaycare.notes: Cronoshare Cagliari-area boarding guide: 15-20 EUR/day standard, 20-26 EUR/day for a large dog, ~8-10 EUR/hour daycare. Modeled as ~5-6 boarding days per month on average (holiday trips) at ~23/day.

transportation.notes: One compact car: fuel at MIMIT 1 Nov 2026 national self-service average (petrol 2.010, diesel 2.241 EUR/l) for ~800 km/mo = ~95; RC auto Sardinia average 488 EUR/yr (Facile.it Oct 2026) = 41; maintenance/tyres ~40; bollo and revisione ~15. Cagliari CTM monthly pass ~36 EUR (Numbeo via Expatica) as an alternative; island transit outside Cagliari is sparse so a car is near-essential.

medicalOOP.notes: Italian out-of-pocket health spending was 41.3 bn EUR in 2024 (~700 EUR per person per year); excluding drugs (carried in medicine) leaves ~45-50 per person per month for private specialist visits (~110 EUR each), ticket co-pays and dental, so ~95/mo for two.
